sections.title: High Severity
sections.content:
**1. Redundant DB ownership checks on every request**
`routes/mentions.ts`, `stats.ts`, `clusters.ts`, `leads.ts`, `jobs.ts` — each independently runs `SELECT * FROM competitors WHERE id=? AND workspace_id=?`. A single competitor detail page load fires this 4–5 times in parallel.

**Fix:** Extract into a `requireCompetitorAccess` preHandler that attaches `request.competitor` once:
```typescript
// packages/api/src/plugins/auth.ts
export async function requireCompetitorAccess(request, reply) {
  const [competitor] = await db.select().from(competitors)
    .where(and(eq(competitors.id, request.params.id), eq(competitors.workspaceId, request.user.workspaceId)))
    .limit(1);
  if (!competitor) return reply.status(404).send({ error: "NOT_FOUND" });
  request.competitor = competitor;
}
```

---

**2. Full table scan + in-memory filter for unclassified mentions**
`classification.processor.ts:41-48` — fetches *every* classification row with no `WHERE` clause, then filters in JS. Grows unbounded.

**Fix:** Push the filter to the DB with a `LEFT JOIN IS NULL`:
```typescript
const unclassified = await db
  .select({ id: mentions.id })
  .from(mentions)
  .innerJoin(competitorMentions, eq(competitorMentions.mentionId, mentions.id))
  .leftJoin(classifications, eq(classifications.mentionId, mentions.id))
  .where(and(eq(competitorMentions.competitorId, competitorId), isNull(classifications.mentionId)));
```

---

**3. N+1 queries + sequential LLM calls in clustering**
`clustering.processor.ts:30-104` — `upsertCluster()` is called sequentially in a `for` loop. Each iteration does up to 4 DB round-trips plus 1 LLM call. 10 groups = 40 queries + 10 serial API calls.

**Fix:** Batch-fetch all existing clusters once, then `Promise.all()` the LLM label generations.

---

sections.title: Medium Severity
sections.content:
**4. New Anthropic SDK instance on every LLM call**
`llm/llm-client.ts:31-32` — destroys the HTTP connection pool each call.

**Fix:** Lazy singleton:
```typescript
let _anthropic: Anthropic | null = null;
function getClient() {
  if (!_anthropic) _anthropic = new Anthropic({ apiKey: config.anthropicApiKey });
  return _anthropic;
}
```

---

**5. LLM API call on every `/health` probe**
`app.ts:72-95` — if used as a liveness probe at 30s intervals, this burns 1,800+ paid API calls/hour.

**Fix:** Keep `/health` free, move LLM check to `/health/deep` with a 5 req/min rate limit.

---

**6. Frontend polls all 4 APIs every 30s regardless of active tab**
`competitors/[id]/page.tsx:60-83` — leads and stats endpoints run heavy joins on every poll even when the user is on a different tab.

**Fix:** Gate fetches by `tab` state — only fetch what the active tab needs.

---

**7. Unmemorized derived computations in render**
- `sales-tab.tsx:111` — `buildTargetCounts(leads)` iterates leads on every render
- `growth-tab.tsx:281` — `aggregateAlternatives(leads)` same issue

**Fix:**
```typescript
const targetCounts = useMemo(() => buildTargetCounts(leads), [leads]);
const alternatives = useMemo(() => aggregateAlternatives(leads), [leads]);
```

---

**8. Client-side sort after fetch in PMTab sub-components**
`pm-tab.tsx:235-251`, `pm-tab.tsx:398-413` — fetches data then `[...res.items].sort(...)` on every mount. Tab switching re-fires both requests.

**Fix:** Add `ORDER BY score DESC` in the mentions query; lift fetches up to `PMTab` so they don't re-run on sub-component remounts.

---

sections.title: Low Severity
sections.content:
**9. `SELECT *` when only `id` is needed** — `workers/src/index.ts:74-78`
Change to `.select({ id: competitors.id })`.

**10. Missing `Cache-Control: no-store` headers** — `app.ts` + `lib/api.ts`
Add a global `onSend` hook for `/api/*` routes and `cache: "no-store"` on fetch calls to prevent browser caching stale auth'd responses.

**11. Auth refetch on every layout mount** — `dashboard/layout.tsx:18-26`
Convert `DashboardLayout` to a Server Component or use React Context to share the user object without re-fetching on every navigation.
